skill.summary: CornerStone MCP x402 skill for agents. Tools for stock predictions, backtests, bank linking, and agent/borrower scores. Payment-protected MCP tools (run_prediction, run_backtest, link_bank_account, get_agent_reputation_score, get_borrower_score, by-email variants) with x402 flow (Aptos + Base). Skill handles 402 → pay → retry. Wallet attestation for onboarding. For marketplaces where agents download and use skills autonomously.
